title: Handheld Halting
description: Simulate a simple VM to detect infinite loops, then fix the program by swapping one instruction.
writeup:
## Approach

The VM has three instructions: `acc` (adjust accumulator), `jmp` (jump), and `nop` (no-op). Detect loops by tracking visited program counter values.

## Part 1

Run the program and track which instructions have been executed. When the program counter revisits an instruction, report the current accumulator value.

## Part 2

The program has exactly one corrupted `jmp` or `nop`. Try swapping each `jmp`<->`nop` one at a time and re-run. The first modification that lets the program terminate normally (pc reaches end) gives the answer.
